research_notes: The eventual strict-probe summary can include a monotonically increasing evidence generation or probe timestamp to simplify reconciliation.
State/current can store last_probe_id and classification as a cache of immutable evidence.
This cache must be rebuildable if inconsistent.
That design keeps mutable state small and recoverable.
The current state already uses last_probe_id/result fields in this spirit.
A clean close will update them only after the immutable close file succeeds.
